        }
        
        function updateDisplay() {
            if (gameState === 'menu') {
                document.getElementById('levelDisplay').textContent = '🎮 SUPER AVENTUREIRO 2';
            } else {
                document.getElementById('levelDisplay').textContent = `FASE ${currentLevel} / 5`;
            }
            document.getElementById('scoreDisplay').textContent = `⭐ Moedas: ${totalCoins} / ${coinsPerLevel}`;
            document.getElementById('livesDisplay').textContent = godMode ? '👑 ∞ Vidas' : `❤️ Vidas: ${lives}`;
            
            const godmodeDisplay = document.getElementById('godmodeDisplay');
            if (godMode) {
                godmodeDisplay.style.display = 'block';
            } else {
                godmodeDisplay.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }
        
        window.addEventListener("gamepadconnected", (e) => {
            console.log("Gamepad conectado:", e.gamepad.id);
            gamepadConnected = true;
        });
        
        window.addEventListener("gamepaddisconnected", (e) => {
            console.log("Gamepad desconectado:", e.gamepad.id);
            gamepadConnected = false;
        });
        
        window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            keys[e.code] = true;
            if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'ShiftLeft' || e.code === 'ShiftRight') {
                e.preventDefault();
            }
            
        });
        
        window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
            keys[e.code] = false;
        });
        
        function getGamepadInput() {
            const gamepads = navigator.getGamepads();
            if (!gamepads) return null;
            for (const gamepad of gamepads) {
                if (gamepad && gamepad.connected) {
                    gamepadConnected = true;
                    return gamepad;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        function handleGodMode(gamepad) {
            const kbActive = !!(keys['KeyR'] && keys['KeyL']);
            const gpActive = !!(gamepad && gamepad.buttons[4]?.pressed && gamepad.buttons[5]?.pressed);
            const comboActive = kbActive || gpActive;
            if (comboActive && !godComboWasActive) {
                godMode = !godMode;
                updateDisplay();
            }
            godComboWasActive = comboActive;
        }
        
        function update() {
            const gamepad = getGamepadInput();
            handleGodMode(gamepad);

            // MENU
            if (gameState === 'menu') {
                if (keys['Enter'] || keys['Space'] || (gamepad && gamepad.buttons[0]?.pressed)) {
                    gameState = 'playing';
                    currentLevel = 1;
                    lives = 3;
                    loadLevel(1);
                    updateDisplay();
                }
                return;
            }
            
            // GAMEOVER / WIN / BOSS DEFEATED
            if (gameState === 'gameover' || gameState === 'win' || gameState === 'bossDefeated') {
                if (keys['Enter'] || (gamepad && gamepad.buttons[0]?.pressed)) {
                    if (gameState === 'gameover') {
                        if (godMode) {
                            // No god mode, só continua
                            loadLevel(currentLevel);
                            gameState = 'playing';
                        } else {
                            lives--;
                            if (lives <= 0) {
                                lives = 3;
                                currentLevel = 1;
                                loadLevel(1);
                            } else {
                                loadLevel(currentLevel);
                            }
                            gameState = 'playing';
                        }
                    } else if (gameState === 'win' || gameState === 'bossDefeated') {
                        if (currentLevel < 5) {
                            currentLevel++;
                            loadLevel(currentLevel);
                            gameState = 'playing';
                        } else {
                            currentLevel = 1;
                            lives = 3;
                            loadLevel(1);
                            gameState = 'playing';
                        }
                    }
                }
                return;
            }
            
            if (player.invincible > 0) player.invincible--;
            if (player.dashCooldown > 0) player.dashCooldown--;
            
            let moveLeft = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'];
            let moveRight = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'];
            let jump = keys['Space'] || keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'];
            let dash = keys['ShiftLeft'] || keys['ShiftRight'] || keys['KeyX'];
            
            if (gamepad) {
                if (gamepad.axes[0] < -0.5) moveLeft = true;
                if (gamepad.axes[0] > 0.5) moveRight = true;
                if (gamepad.buttons[14]?.pressed) moveLeft = true;
                if (gamepad.buttons[15]?.pressed) moveRight = true;
                if (gamepad.buttons[0]?.pressed) jump = true;
                if (gamepad.buttons[2]?.pressed) dash = true;
            }
            
            // DASH
            if (dash && !player.dashing && player.dashCooldown <= 0) {
                player.dashing = true;
                player.dashDuration = 10;
                player.dashCooldown = 30;
                player.vy = 0;
            }
            
            if (player.dashing) {
                player.vx = player.facing * player.dashSpeed;
                player.dashDuration--;
                if (player.dashDuration <= 0) {
                    player.dashing = false;
                    player.vx = 0;
                }
            } else {
                if (moveLeft) {
                    player.vx = -player.speed;
                    player.facing = -1;
                } else if (moveRight) {
                    player.vx = player.speed;
                    player.facing = 1;
                } else {
                    player.vx = 0;
                }
            }
            
            if (jump && player.grounded) {
                player.vy = player.jumpForce;
                player.grounded = false;
            }
            
            player.vy += player.gravity;
            player.y += player.vy;
            
            // Colisão plataformas
            player.grounded = false;
            for (let plat of platforms) {
                if (player.x < plat.x + plat.width &&
                    player.x + player.width > plat.x &&
                    player.y < plat.y + plat.height &&
                    player.y + player.height > plat.y) {
                    
                    if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.height - player.vy <= plat.y) {
                        player.y = plat.y - player.height;
                        player.vy = 0;
                        player.grounded = true;
                    } else if (player.vy < 0 && player.y - player.vy >= plat.y + plat.height) {
                        player.y = plat.y + plat.height;
                        player.vy = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            player.x += player.vx;
            for (let plat of platforms) {
                if (player.x < plat.x + plat.width &&
                    player.x + player.width > plat.x &&
                    player.y < plat.y + plat.height &&
                    player.y + player.height > plat.y) {
                    
                    if (player.vx > 0) {
                        player.x = plat.x - player.width;
                    } else if (player.vx < 0) {
                        player.x = plat.x + plat.width;
                    }
                    player.vx = 0;
                }
            }
            
            if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
            if (player.x > levelWidth - player.width) player.x = levelWidth - player.width;
            
            cameraX = player.x - canvas.width / 3;
            if (cameraX < 0) cameraX = 0;
            if (cameraX > levelWidth - canvas.width) cameraX = levelWidth - canvas.width;
            
            if (player.y > canvas.height) {
                if (godMode) {
                    player.y = 300;
                    player.vy = 0;
                    player.x = 50;
                    cameraX = 0;
                } else {
                    loseLife();
                }
            }
            
            // Atualizar inimigos
            for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                let enemy = enemies[i];
                
                if (enemy.type === 'walker') {
                    enemy.x += enemy.vx;
                    let enemyGrounded = false;
                    for (let plat of platforms) {
                        if (enemy.x < plat.x + plat.width &&
                            enemy.x + enemy.width > plat.x &&
                            enemy.y + enemy.height <= plat.y + plat.height &&
                            enemy.y + enemy.height >= plat.y) {
                            enemyGrounded = true;
                        }
                    }
                    if (enemy.x <= 0 || enemy.x >= levelWidth - enemy.width || !enemyGrounded) {
                        enemy.vx = -enemy.vx;
                    }
                } else if (enemy.type === 'flyer') {
                    enemy.x += enemy.vx;
                    enemy.y = enemy.baseY + Math.sin(Date.now() / 500) * enemy.amplitude;
                    if (enemy.x <= 0 || enemy.x >= levelWidth - enemy.width) {
                        enemy.vx = -enemy.vx;
                    }
                }
                
                // Colisão jogador-inimigo
                if (player.x < enemy.x + enemy.width &&
                    player.x + player.width > enemy.x &&
                    player.y < enemy.y + enemy.height &&
                    player.y + player.height > enemy.y) {
                    
                    // Pulando em cima do inimigo (knockback melhorado)
                    if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.height - player.vy <= enemy.y + 10) {
                        enemies.splice(i, 1);
                        player.vy = player.jumpForce * 1.4; // Knockback muito mais forte
                    } else if (player.dashing) {
                        enemies.splice(i, 1);
                    } else if (!godMode && player.invincible <= 0) {
                        loseLife();
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Boss update
            if (boss && boss.hp > 0) {
                if (boss.invincible > 0) boss.invincible--;
                if (boss.attackCooldown > 0) boss.attackCooldown--;
                
                boss.x += boss.vx;
                if (boss.x <= 1700 || boss.x >= levelWidth - boss.width - 50) {
                    boss.vx = -boss.vx;
                }
                
                // Colisão com jogador
                if (player.x < boss.x + boss.width &&
                    player.x + player.width > boss.x &&
                    player.y < boss.y + boss.height &&
                    player.y + player.height > boss.y) {
                    
                    // Pulando na cabeça do boss
                    if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.height - player.vy <= boss.y + 15 && boss.invincible <= 0) {
                        boss.hp--;
                        boss.invincible = 30;
                        player.vy = player.jumpForce * 1.5; // Knockback muito forte
                        player.y = boss.y - player.height; // Garante que fique acima
                        
                        console.log('Boss hit! HP:', boss.hp);
                        
                        if (boss.hp <= 0) {
                            boss = null;
                            gameState = 'bossDefeated';
                        }
                    } else if (player.dashing && boss.invincible <= 0) {
                        boss.hp--;
                        boss.invincible = 30;
                        player.vx = -player.facing * 8; // Recuo do dash
                        
                        console.log('Boss hit by dash! HP:', boss.hp);
                        
                        if (boss.hp <= 0) {
                            boss = null;
                            gameState = 'bossDefeated';
                        }
                    } else if (!godMode && player.invincible <= 0 && boss.invincible <= 0) {
                        loseLife();
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Moedas
            for (let coin of coins) {
                if (!coin.collected) {
                    if (player.x < coin.x + 15 &&
                        player.x + player.width > coin.x &&
                        player.y < coin.y + 15 &&
                        player.y + player.height > coin.y) {
                        coin.collected = true;
                        totalCoins++;
                        updateDisplay();
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Bandeira
            if (player.x < flag.x + flag.width &&
                player.x + player.width > flag.x &&
                player.y < flag.y + flag.height &&
                player.y + player.height > flag.y) {
                
                if (totalCoins >= coinsPerLevel) {
                    if (currentLevel === 5 && boss && boss.hp > 0) {
                        // Não pode passar sem matar o boss
                    } else {
                        gameState = 'win';
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (gameState === 'bossDefeated') {
                if (player.x < flag.x + flag.width &&
                    player.x + player.width > flag.x &&
                    player.y < flag.y + flag.height &&
                    player.y + player.height > flag.y &&
                    totalCoins >= coinsPerLevel) {
                    gameState = 'win';
                }
            }
        }
        
        function loseLife() {
            if (godMode) return; // Modo invencível ignora dano
            
            lives--;
            updateDisplay();
            
            if (lives <= 0) {
                gameState = 'gameover';
                lives = 0;
            } else {
                player.x = 50;
                player.y = 300;
                player.vy = 0;
                player.invincible = 60;
                cameraX = 0;
            }
        }
        
        function draw() {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(-cameraX, 0);
            
            // Fundo
            const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
            if (currentLevel === 5) {
                gradient.addColorStop(0, '#2c3e50');
                gradient.addColorStop(1, '#34495e');
            } else {
                gradient.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB');
                gradient.addColorStop(1, '#98FB98');
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, levelWidth, canvas.height);
            
            // Nuvens
            if (currentLevel !== 5) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                    let cloudX = (i * 250 + 100) % levelWidth;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(cloudX, 50, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.arc(cloudX + 30, 45, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.arc(cloudX + 60, 50, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            }
            
            // Plataformas
            for (let plat of platforms) {
                ctx.fillStyle = plat.color;
                ctx.fillRect(plat.x, plat.y, plat.width, plat.height);
                ctx.strokeStyle = '#3e2723';
                ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                for (let i = 0; i < plat.width; i += 20) {
                    ctx.strokeRect(plat.x + i, plat.y, 20, plat.height);
                }
            }
            
            // Moedas
            for (let coin of coins) {
                if (!coin.collected) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(coin.x + 7, coin.y + 7, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFA500';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                    ctx.stroke();
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF8DC';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(coin.x + 5, coin.y + 5, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            }
            
            // Inimigos
            for (let enemy of enemies) {
                if (enemy.type === 'walker') {
                    ctx.fillStyle = enemy.color;
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x, enemy.y, enemy.width, enemy.height);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 5, enemy.y + 5, 8, 8);
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 17, enemy.y + 5, 8, 8);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 7, enemy.y + 7, 4, 4);
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 19, enemy.y + 7, 4, 4);
                } else if (enemy.type === 'flyer') {
                    ctx.fillStyle = enemy.color;
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x, enemy.y, enemy.width, enemy.height);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#f39c12';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(enemy.x - 5, enemy.y + 10);
                    ctx.lineTo(enemy.x - 15, enemy.y);
                    ctx.lineTo(enemy.x - 5, enemy.y + 20);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(enemy.x + enemy.width + 5, enemy.y + 10);
                    ctx.lineTo(enemy.x + enemy.width + 15, enemy.y);
                    ctx.lineTo(enemy.x + enemy.width + 5, enemy.y + 20);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 5, enemy.y + 8, 8, 8);
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 17, enemy.y + 8, 8, 8);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 7, enemy.y + 10, 4, 4);
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 19, enemy.y + 10, 4, 4);
                }
            }
            
            // Boss
            if (boss && boss.hp > 0) {
                ctx.fillStyle = boss.invincible % 10 < 5 ? boss.color : '#f1c40f';
                ctx.fillRect(boss.x, boss.y, boss.width, boss.height);
                
                ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(boss.x, boss.y);
                ctx.lineTo(boss.x + 10, boss.y - 20);
                ctx.lineTo(boss.x + 20, boss.y - 5);
                ctx.lineTo(boss.x + 30, boss.y - 25);
                ctx.lineTo(boss.x + 40, boss.y - 5);
                ctx.lineTo(boss.x + 50, boss.y - 20);
                ctx.lineTo(boss.x + 60, boss.y);
                ctx.fill();
                
                ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
                ctx.fillRect(boss.x + 10, boss.y + 10, 12, 12);
                ctx.fillRect(boss.x + 38, boss.y + 10, 12, 12);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
                ctx.fillRect(boss.x + 14, boss.y + 14, 4, 4);
                ctx.fillRect(boss.x + 42, boss.y + 14, 4, 4);
                
                ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
                ctx.fillRect(boss.x, boss.y - 35, boss.width, 8);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
                ctx.fillRect(boss.x, boss.y - 35, boss.width * (boss.hp / boss.maxHp), 8);
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'white';
                ctx.strokeRect(boss.x, boss.y - 35, boss.width, 8);
            }
            
            // Bandeira
            if (!boss || boss.hp <= 0 || currentLevel !== 5) {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
                ctx.fillRect(flag.x, flag.y, 5, flag.height);
                const flagColors = ['#e74c3c', '#3498db', '#f1c40f', '#9b59b6', '#e67e22'];
                ctx.fillStyle = flagColors[currentLevel - 1];
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(flag.x + 5, flag.y);
                ctx.lineTo(flag.x + 30, flag.y + 15);
                ctx.lineTo(flag.x + 5, flag.y + 30);
                ctx.fill();
            }
            
            // Jogador
            if (player.invincible % 10 < 5 || player.invincible <= 0 || godMode) {
                ctx.fillStyle = godMode ? '#f1c40f' : (player.dashing ? '#f39c12' : player.color);
                ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.width, player.height);
                
                if (godMode) {
                    // Efeito de aura no modo invencível
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#f1c40f';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
                    ctx.strokeRect(player.x - 3, player.y - 3, player.width + 6, player.height + 6);
                }
                
                ctx.fillStyle = '#c0392b';
                ctx.fillRect(player.x - 2, player.y - 8, player.width + 4, 10);
                
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                if (player.facing === 1) {
                    ctx.fillRect(player.x + 20, player.y + 8, 8, 8);
                } else {
                    ctx.fillRect(player.x + 2, player.y + 8, 8, 8);
                }
                ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
                if (player.facing === 1) {
                    ctx.fillRect(player.x + 22, player.y + 10, 4, 4);
                } else {
                    ctx.fillRect(player.x + 4, player.y + 10, 4, 4);
                }
            }
            
            ctx.restore();
            
            // Overlays
            if (gameState === 'menu') {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                
                ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
                ctx.font = '50px Arial';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText('SUPER AVENTUREIRO 2', canvas.width / 2, 120);
                
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                ctx.font = '24px Arial';
                ctx.fillText('🎮 Controles:', canvas.width / 2, 200);
                ctx.font = '18px Arial';
                ctx.fillText('Setas/WASD: Mover | Espaço: Pular | Shift/X: Dash', canvas.width / 2, 240);
                ctx.fillText('Pular em inimigos: Derrotar (knockback melhorado!)', canvas.width / 2, 270);
                ctx.fillText('🎮 Gamepad: A=Pular | X=Dash | D-Pad=Mover', canvas.width / 2, 300);
                ctx.fillText('👑 Segredo: R+L (teclado) ou LB+RB (gamepad) = Modo Invencível', canvas.width / 2, 330);
                
                ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
                ctx.font = '30px Arial';
                const blink = Math.sin(Date.now() / 500) > 0;
                if (blink) {
                    ctx.fillText('PRESSIONE ENTER OU 🎮 A PARA COMEÇAR', canvas.width / 2, 370);
                }
            } else if (gameState === 'gameover') {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
                ctx.font = '40px Arial';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                ctx.font = '20px Arial';
                ctx.fillText(`Vidas restantes: ${godMode ? '∞' : lives}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
                ctx.fillText('Pressione ENTER ou 🎮 A para continuar', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 50);
            } else if (gameState === 'win') {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
                ctx.font = '40px Arial';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                if (currentLevel < 5) {
                    ctx.fillText(`FASE ${currentLevel} COMPLETA!`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
                } else {
                    ctx.fillText('🏆 VITÓRIA FINAL! 🏆', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
                }
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                ctx.font = '20px Arial';
                ctx.fillText('Pressione ENTER ou 🎮 A para continuar', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
            } else if (gameState === 'bossDefeated') {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
                ctx.font = '40px Arial';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText('BOSS DERROTADO!', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                ctx.font = '20px Arial';
                ctx.fillText('Agora vá até a bandeira para completar a fase!', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
            }
        }
        
        function gameLoop() {
            update();
            draw();
            requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
        }
        
        loadLevel(1);
        gameState = 'menu';
        updateDisplay();
        gameLoop();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<style>

  background:#000; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center;
  height:100vh; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden;
}

@keyframes pulse { from{opacity:.5} to{opacity:1} }
</style>

<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<div id="info">
  <div id="levelDisplay">MENU</div>
  <div class="hud">
    <div id="scoreDisplay">⭐ 0 / 8</div>
    <div id="livesDisplay">❤️ Vidas: 3</div>
  </div>
  <div id="godmodeDisplay" style="display:none;" class="god">👑 MODO INVENCÍVEL</div>
  <div class="controls" style="color:#888;font-size:12px;margin-top:4px">
    🎮 A=pular · X=dash · B=atirar · LB+RB=Invencível &nbsp;|&nbsp;
    ⌨️ Setas+Espaço · Shift=dash · Z=atirar · R+L=Invencível
  </div>

<script>
'use strict';

const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx    = canvas.getContext('2d');
canvas.width = 800; canvas.height = 400;

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ESTADO GLOBAL
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let gameState = 'menu';   // menu | playing | bossDefeated | win | gameover
let currentLevel = 1;
let totalCoins   = 0;
const COINS_PER_LEVEL = 8;
let lives = 3;
let cameraX = 0;
const LW = 2400; // largura do nivel

let godMode          = false;
let godComboWasActive= false;
let jumpWasPressed   = false;
let shootWasPressed  = false;
let shootCooldown    = 0;
let doubleJumpMsgTimer = 0;
let postBossTimer    = 0;   // delay antes de poder avançar apos boss

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   JOGADOR
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const player = {
  x:50, y:300, width:30, height:40,
  vx:0, vy:0, speed:5,
  jumpForce:-11, gravity:0.6,
  grounded:false, color:'#1a3a5c',
  facing:1, invincible:0,
  dashing:false, dashCooldown:0, dashSpeed:12, dashDuration:0,
  jumpsLeft:1, maxJumps:1,
};

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ENTIDADES
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let platforms=[], enemies=[], coins=[], playerBullets=[], enemyBullets=[];
let boss = null;
let flag = {x:0,y:0,width:20,height:60};

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   INPUT
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
  keys[e.code]=true;
  if(['Space','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ShiftLeft','ShiftRight'].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', e=>{ keys[e.code]=false; });

function getGamepad(){
  const gs=navigator.getGamepads(); if(!gs) return null;
  for(const g of gs) if(g&&g.connected) return g;
  return null;
}
function handleGodMode(gp){
  const kb=!!(keys['KeyR']&&keys['KeyL']);
  const gpa=!!(gp&&gp.buttons[4]?.pressed&&gp.buttons[5]?.pressed);
  const on=kb||gpa;
  if(on&&!godComboWasActive){godMode=!godMode;updateDisplay();}
  godComboWasActive=on;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FACTORIES
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const mkWalker=(x,y,vx,color)=>
  ({x,y,width:30,height:30,vx,color,type:'walker',hp:1});

const mkFlyer=(x,y,vx,amp,color)=>
  ({x,y,width:30,height:30,vx,amplitude:amp,baseY:y,vy:0,color,type:'flyer',hp:1});

const mkShooter=(x,y,vx,color)=>({
  x,y,width:32,height:32,vx,color,type:'shooter',hp:1,
  shootCooldown:Math.floor(Math.random()*80),
  shootInterval:90, facing:vx>0?1:-1,
});

const mkBoss1=(x,y)=>({
  x,y,width:52,height:72,vx:2.5,
  hp:5,maxHp:5,color:'#c0392b',
  invincible:0,type:'boss1',
  attackCooldown:80,shootInterval:80,
  name:'TENENTE SCARFACE',
});

const mkBoss2=(x,y)=>({
  x,y,width:62,height:88,vx:3,
  hp:8,maxHp:8,color:'#1a0d05',
  invincible:0,type:'boss2',
  attackCooldown:55,shootInterval:55,
  name:'DON DIAMANTE',
});

function mkCoins(...pts){ return pts.map(([x,y])=>({x,y,collected:false})); }

function levelCol(lv){
  if(lv<=2)  return {w:'#27ae60',f:'#e67e22',s:'#8e44ad'};
  if(lv<=4)  return {w:'#2980b9',f:'#f39c12',s:'#6c3483'};
  if(lv===5) return {w:'#c0392b',f:'#e74c3c',s:'#7d3c98'};
  if(lv<=7)  return {w:'#2ecc71',f:'#f39c12',s:'#8e44ad'};
  if(lv<=9)  return {w:'#e74c3c',f:'#c0392b',s:'#a93226'};
  return              {w:'#7f8c8d',f:'#c0392b',s:'#7d3c98'};
}
const PC=(lv)=>lv<=5?'#5a5a6a':'#3a3a4a';
const PS=(lv)=>lv<=5?'#3d3d50':'#252535';

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CARREGA NÍVEL
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function loadLevel(lv){
  platforms=[];enemies=[];coins=[];
  playerBullets=[];enemyBullets=[];
  boss=null;

  const pc=PC(lv), ps=PS(lv);
  const gnd={x:0,y:370,width:LW,height:30,color:pc,stroke:ps};
  platforms.push(gnd);

  const col=levelCol(lv);
  player.maxJumps = lv>=6?2:1;
  if(lv===6) doubleJumpMsgTimer=240;

  // helpers
  const ap=(x,y,w)=>platforms.push({x,y,width:w,height:15,color:pc,stroke:ps});
  const aw=(x,y,vx)=>enemies.push(mkWalker(x,y,vx,col.w));
  const af=(x,y,vx,amp)=>enemies.push(mkFlyer(x,y,vx,amp,col.f));
  const as=(x,y,vx)=>enemies.push(mkShooter(x,y,vx,col.s));
  const ac=(...pts)=>coins.push(...mkCoins(...pts));

  switch(lv){
    /* ── MISSÃO 1: Rua da Cidade ── */
    case 1:
      ap(200,320,100);ap(420,270,120);ap(660,308,100);
      ap(900,252,110);ap(1150,308,120);ap(1400,260,100);
      ap(1650,308,120);ap(1900,248,100);ap(2100,295,120);
      aw(300,340,1.5);aw(700,340,-1.5);
      ac([225,290],[445,240],[685,278],[925,222],[1175,278],[1425,230],[1675,278],[1925,218]);
      flag={x:2300,y:310,width:20,height:60}; break;

    /* ── MISSÃO 2: Beco Escuro ── */
    case 2:
      ap(150,330,90);ap(330,280,90);ap(510,240,90);
      ap(730,300,90);ap(950,252,90);ap(1170,308,90);
      ap(1390,260,90);ap(1620,302,90);ap(1850,242,90);ap(2070,292,90);
      aw(400,340,2.0);aw(900,340,-2.0);
      as(650,340,1.5);
      ac([175,300],[355,250],[535,210],[755,270],[975,222],[1395,230],[1645,272],[1875,212]);
      flag={x:2300,y:310,width:20,height:60}; break;

    /* ── MISSÃO 3: Telhados ── */
    case 3:
      ap(100,340,80);ap(280,290,80);ap(460,240,80);
      ap(660,300,80);ap(860,252,80);ap(1060,202,80);
      ap(1260,260,80);ap(1460,308,80);ap(1660,240,80);
      ap(1860,192,80);ap(2060,280,80);
      aw(300,340,2.2);af(600,200,1.5,60);as(1100,340,-1.8);
      ac([125,310],[305,260],[485,210],[685,270],[885,222],[1085,172],[1485,278],[1885,162]);
      flag={x:2300,y:310,width:20,height:60}; break;

    /* ── MISSÃO 4: Estacionamento Subterrâneo ── */
    case 4:
      ap(150,340,100);ap(350,300,100);ap(550,260,100);
      ap(750,308,100);ap(950,260,100);ap(1150,210,100);
      ap(1350,270,100);ap(1550,318,100);ap(1750,262,100);
      ap(1950,212,100);ap(2150,292,100);
      aw(250,340,2.5);aw(850,340,-2.5);
      as(600,340,1.8);as(1600,340,-2.0);
      ac([175,310],[375,270],[575,230],[775,278],[975,230],[1175,180],[1775,232],[2175,262]);
      flag={x:2300,y:310,width:20,height:60}; break;

    /* ── MISSÃO 5: BOSS — Tenente Scarface ── */
    case 5:
      ap(200,330,150);ap(600,280,150);ap(1100,252,150);
      ap(1600,302,150);ap(2000,262,150);
      aw(300,340,2.0);af(700,200,-1.5,70);
      boss=mkBoss1(2000,272);
      ac([225,300],[625,252],[1125,222],[1625,272],[500,340],[900,340],[1400,340],[1800,340]);
      flag={x:2300,y:310,width:20,height:60}; break;

    /* ── MISSÃO 6: Cidade Profunda — PULO DUPLO! ── */
    case 6:
      ap(100,340,80);ap(280,280,80);ap(480,222,80);
      ap(700,282,80);ap(920,230,80);ap(1120,172,80);
      ap(1350,242,80);ap(1580,302,80);ap(1800,222,80);
      ap(2000,172,80);ap(2200,252,80);
      aw(350,340,2.5);aw(1000,340,-2.5);
      as(800,340,2.0);as(1700,340,-2.2);
      af(1400,188,1.8,60);
      ac([125,310],[305,250],[505,192],[725,252],[945,200],[1145,142],[1605,272],[1825,192]);
      flag={x:2300,y:310,width:20,height:60}; break;

    /* ── MISSÃO 7: Distrito dos Cassinos ── */
    case 7:
      ap(120,330,90);ap(320,280,90);ap(520,230,90);
      ap(750,290,90);ap(980,242,90);ap(1200,190,90);
      ap(1420,262,90);ap(1650,308,90);ap(1870,242,90);
      ap(2070,182,90);
      aw(220,340,2.8);aw(850,340,-2.8);aw(1700,340,3.0);
      as(600,340,2.0);as(1300,340,-2.2);
      ac([145,300],[345,250],[545,200],[775,260],[1005,212],[1225,160],[1675,278],[1895,212]);
      flag={x:2300,y:310,width:20,height:60}; break;

    /* ── MISSÃO 8: Esgotos ── */
    case 8:
      ap(100,348,70);ap(260,298,70);ap(420,248,70);
      ap(600,308,70);ap(780,260,70);ap(960,210,70);
      ap(1160,280,70);ap(1360,318,70);ap(1560,248,70);
      ap(1760,198,70);ap(1960,280,70);ap(2160,228,70);
      af(400,200,2.0,70);af(1200,210,-2.0,70);
      as(500,340,2.0);as(900,340,-2.2);as(1600,340,2.5);
      ac([125,318],[285,268],[445,218],[625,278],[805,230],[985,180],[1585,218],[1785,168]);
      flag={x:2300,y:310,width:20,height:60}; break;

    /* ── MISSÃO 9: QG da Máfia ── */
    case 9:
      ap(150,330,80);ap(330,270,80);ap(530,210,80);
      ap(730,280,80);ap(930,230,80);ap(1130,170,80);
      ap(1330,250,80);ap(1540,308,80);ap(1740,242,80);
      ap(1940,182,80);ap(2140,272,80);
      aw(250,340,3.0);aw(800,340,-3.0);aw(1600,340,3.0);
      af(600,180,2.0,75);af(1400,190,-2.2,70);
      as(400,340,2.5);as(1250,340,-2.5);
      ac([175,300],[355,240],[555,180],[755,250],[955,200],[1155,140],[1765,212],[1965,152]);
      flag={x:2300,y:310,width:20,height:60}; break;

    /* ── MISSÃO 10: BOSS FINAL — Don Diamante ── */
    case 10:
      ap(150,330,130);ap(450,270,130);ap(800,242,130);
      ap(1150,302,130);ap(1500,262,130);ap(1900,222,130);
      as(300,340,2.0);as(600,340,-2.0);
      boss=mkBoss2(2000,268);
      ac([175,300],[475,240],[825,212],[1175,272],[1525,232],[1000,340],[1700,340],[1925,192]);
      flag={x:2300,y:310,width:20,height:60}; break;
  }

  coins.forEach(c=>c.collected=false);
  Object.assign(player,{
    x:50,y:300,vx:0,vy:0,
    dashing:false,dashCooldown:0,dashDuration:0,
    invincible:0,jumpsLeft:player.maxJumps,
  });
  totalCoins=0; cameraX=0;
  shootCooldown=0; jumpWasPressed=false; shootWasPressed=false;
  updateDisplay();
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DISPLAY
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function updateDisplay(){
  document.getElementById('levelDisplay').textContent =
    gameState==='menu' ? '🕵️ SUPER AVENTUREIRO 2: AGENT EDITION'
                       : `MISSÃO ${currentLevel} / 10`;
  document.getElementById('scoreDisplay').textContent = `⭐ ${totalCoins} / ${COINS_PER_LEVEL}`;
  document.getElementById('livesDisplay').textContent = godMode?'👑 ∞ Vidas':`❤️ Vidas: ${lives}`;
  document.getElementById('godmodeDisplay').style.display = godMode?'block':'none';
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FÍSICA
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function isGrounded(ent){
  const cx=ent.x+ent.width/2, fy=ent.y+ent.height;
  for(const p of platforms)
    if(cx>=p.x&&cx<=p.x+p.width&&fy>=p.y-2&&fy<=p.y+p.height) return true;
  return false;
}

function loseLife(){
  if(godMode) return;
  lives--; updateDisplay();
  if(lives<=0){ gameState='gameover'; lives=0; return; }
  Object.assign(player,{x:50,y:300,vx:0,vy:0,invincible:90,
    dashing:false,dashCooldown:0,dashDuration:0,jumpsLeft:player.maxJumps});
  cameraX=0; playerBullets=[]; enemyBullets=[];
}

function fireBossShot(b){
  const dir=player.x>b.x?1:-1;
  enemyBullets.push({
    x:b.x+(dir===1?b.width:-14), y:b.y+b.height*0.3,
    vx:6*dir, vy:0, width:14,height:8, active:true, isBoss:true,
  });
  // Don Diamante: segundo tiro quando com HP baixo
  if(b.type==='boss2'&&b.hp<=4){
    enemyBullets.push({
      x:b.x+(dir===1?b.width:-14), y:b.y+b.height*0.6,
      vx:5.5*dir, vy:-0.5, width:12,height:7, active:true, isBoss:true,
    });
  }
}

function advanceLevel(){
  if(currentLevel<10){
    currentLevel++; loadLevel(currentLevel); gameState='playing';
  } else {
    gameState='menu'; currentLevel=1; lives=3; loadLevel(1);
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   UPDATE
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function update(){
  const gp=getGamepad();
  handleGodMode(gp);

  /* ── MENU ── */
  if(gameState==='menu'){
    if(keys['Enter']||keys['Space']||gp?.buttons[0]?.pressed){
      gameState='playing'; currentLevel=1; lives=3; loadLevel(1); updateDisplay();
    }
    return;
  }

  /* ── GAMEOVER / WIN ── */
  if(gameState==='gameover'||gameState==='win'){
    if(keys['Enter']||gp?.buttons[0]?.pressed){
      if(gameState==='gameover'){ lives=3; currentLevel=1; loadLevel(1); gameState='playing'; }
      else advanceLevel();
    }
    return;
  }

  /* ── PLAYING / BOSS DEFEATED ── */
  if(player.invincible>0)  player.invincible--;
  if(player.dashCooldown>0) player.dashCooldown--;
  if(shootCooldown>0)      shootCooldown--;
  if(doubleJumpMsgTimer>0) doubleJumpMsgTimer--;
  if(postBossTimer>0)      postBossTimer--;

  /* Input */
  let moveLeft  = keys['ArrowLeft'] ||keys['KeyA'];
  let moveRight = keys['ArrowRight']||keys['KeyD'];
  const jumpNow  = !!(keys['Space']||keys['ArrowUp']||keys['KeyW']||gp?.buttons[0]?.pressed);
  const jumpJust = jumpNow&&!jumpWasPressed; jumpWasPressed=jumpNow;

  let dash      = !!(keys['ShiftLeft']||keys['ShiftRight']||keys['KeyX']||gp?.buttons[2]?.pressed);
  const shootNow = !!(keys['KeyZ']||keys['KeyC']||gp?.buttons[1]?.pressed);
  const shootJust= shootNow&&!shootWasPressed; shootWasPressed=shootNow;

  if(gp){
    if(gp.axes[0]<-0.5||gp.buttons[14]?.pressed) moveLeft=true;
    if(gp.axes[0]> 0.5||gp.buttons[15]?.pressed) moveRight=true;
  }

  /* Dash */
  if(dash&&!player.dashing&&player.dashCooldown<=0){
    player.dashing=true; player.dashDuration=10; player.dashCooldown=30; player.vy=0;
  }
  if(player.dashing){
    player.vx=player.facing*player.dashSpeed; player.dashDuration--;
    if(player.dashDuration<=0){ player.dashing=false; player.vx=0; }
  } else {
    if(moveLeft)      { player.vx=-player.speed; player.facing=-1; }
    else if(moveRight){ player.vx= player.speed; player.facing= 1; }
    else              { player.vx=0; }
  }

  /* Atirar */
  if(shootJust&&shootCooldown<=0){
    playerBullets.push({
      x:player.x+(player.facing===1?player.width:-12),
      y:player.y+player.height/2-3,
      vx:9*player.facing, width:12,height:6, active:true,
    });
    shootCooldown=18;
  }

  /* Pulo (com pulo duplo) */
  if(jumpJust&&player.jumpsLeft>0){
    player.vy = player.jumpsLeft<player.maxJumps ? player.jumpForce*0.85 : player.jumpForce;
    player.jumpsLeft--; player.grounded=false;
  }

  /* Gravidade + vertical */
  player.vy+=player.gravity; player.y+=player.vy;

  /* Colisão vertical */
  player.grounded=false;
  for(const p of platforms){
    if(player.x<p.x+p.width&&player.x+player.width>p.x&&
       player.y<p.y+p.height&&player.y+player.height>p.y){
      if(player.vy>0&&player.y+player.height-player.vy<=p.y+2){
        player.y=p.y-player.height; player.vy=0; player.grounded=true;
      } else if(player.vy<0&&player.y-player.vy>=p.y+p.height-2){
        player.y=p.y+p.height; player.vy=0;
      }
    }
  }
  if(player.grounded) player.jumpsLeft=player.maxJumps;

  /* Colisão horizontal */
  player.x+=player.vx;
  for(const p of platforms){
    if(player.x<p.x+p.width&&player.x+player.width>p.x&&
       player.y<p.y+p.height&&player.y+player.height>p.y){
      if(player.vx>0) player.x=p.x-player.width;
      else if(player.vx<0) player.x=p.x+p.width;
      player.vx=0;
    }
  }

  /* Limites */
  if(player.x<0) player.x=0;
  if(player.x>LW-player.width) player.x=LW-player.width;

  /* Camera */
  cameraX=player.x-canvas.width/3;
  if(cameraX<0) cameraX=0;
  if(cameraX>LW-canvas.width) cameraX=LW-canvas.width;

  /* Cair */
  if(player.y>canvas.height){
    if(godMode){ player.x=50;player.y=300;player.vy=0;cameraX=0;player.jumpsLeft=player.maxJumps; }
    else{ loseLife(); if(gameState==='gameover') return; }
  }

  /* ── Balas do jogador ── */
  for(let i=playerBullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=playerBullets[i];
    b.x+=b.vx;
    if(b.x<-20||b.x>LW+20){ playerBullets.splice(i,1); continue; }

    // acerta inimigo
    let hit=false;
    for(let j=enemies.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      const e=enemies[j];
      if(b.x<e.x+e.width&&b.x+b.width>e.x&&b.y<e.y+e.height&&b.y+b.height>e.y){
        enemies.splice(j,1); playerBullets.splice(i,1); hit=true; break;
      }
    }
    if(hit) continue;

    // acerta boss
    if(boss&&boss.hp>0&&boss.invincible<=0){
      if(b.x<boss.x+boss.width&&b.x+b.width>boss.x&&
         b.y<boss.y+boss.height&&b.y+b.height>boss.y){
        boss.hp--; boss.invincible=25; playerBullets.splice(i,1);
        if(boss.hp<=0){ boss=null; gameState='bossDefeated'; postBossTimer=90; }
        continue;
      }
    }
  }

  /* ── Balas dos inimigos ── */
  for(let i=enemyBullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=enemyBullets[i];
    if(!b) continue;
    b.x+=b.vx; if(b.vy) b.y+=b.vy;
    if(b.x<-20||b.x>LW+20||b.y>canvas.height){ enemyBullets.splice(i,1); continue; }
    if(!godMode&&player.invincible<=0){
      if(b.x<player.x+player.width&&b.x+b.width>player.x&&
         b.y<player.y+player.height&&b.y+b.height>player.y){
        enemyBullets.splice(i,1);
        loseLife();
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  /* ── Inimigos ── */
  for(let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const e=enemies[i];

    if(e.type==='walker'){
      e.x+=e.vx;
      if(e.x<=0||e.x>=LW-e.width||!isGrounded(e)) e.vx=-e.vx;

    } else if(e.type==='flyer'){
      e.x+=e.vx;
      e.y=e.baseY+Math.sin(Date.now()/500)*e.amplitude;
      if(e.x<=0||e.x>=LW-e.width) e.vx=-e.vx;

    } else if(e.type==='shooter'){
      e.x+=e.vx;
      if(e.x<=0||e.x>=LW-e.width||!isGrounded(e)) e.vx=-e.vx;
      e.facing=player.x>e.x?1:-1;
      if(e.shootCooldown<=0){
        if(Math.abs(player.x-e.x)<650){
          enemyBullets.push({
            x:e.x+(e.facing===1?e.width:-10),
            y:e.y+e.height/2-3,
            vx:5*e.facing, vy:0, width:10,height:5, isBoss:false,
          });
          e.shootCooldown=e.shootInterval;
        } else { e.shootCooldown=30; }
      } else { e.shootCooldown--; }
    }

    /* colisão jogador-inimigo */
    if(player.x<e.x+e.width&&player.x+player.width>e.x&&
       player.y<e.y+e.height&&player.y+player.height>e.y){
      if(player.vy>0&&player.y+player.height-player.vy<=e.y+10){
        enemies.splice(i,1); player.vy=player.jumpForce*1.3;
      } else if(player.dashing){
        enemies.splice(i,1);
      } else if(!godMode&&player.invincible<=0){
        loseLife();
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  /* ── Boss ── */
  if(boss&&boss.hp>0){
    if(boss.invincible>0) boss.invincible--;
    if(boss.attackCooldown>0) boss.attackCooldown--;

    boss.x+=boss.vx;
    if(boss.x<=1650||boss.x>=LW-boss.width-50) boss.vx=-boss.vx;

    if(boss.attackCooldown<=0){
      fireBossShot(boss);
      boss.attackCooldown = boss.hp<=Math.floor(boss.maxHp/2)
        ? Math.floor(boss.shootInterval*0.6)
        : boss.shootInterval;
    }

    if(player.x<boss.x+boss.width&&player.x+player.width>boss.x&&
       player.y<boss.y+boss.height&&player.y+player.height>boss.y){
      if(player.vy>0&&player.y+player.height-player.vy<=boss.y+15&&boss.invincible<=0){
        boss.hp--; boss.invincible=35;
        player.vy=player.jumpForce*1.4; player.y=boss.y-player.height;
        if(boss.hp<=0){ boss=null; gameState='bossDefeated'; postBossTimer=90; }
      } else if(player.dashing&&boss.invincible<=0){
        boss.hp--; boss.invincible=35; player.vx=-player.facing*8;
        if(boss.hp<=0){ boss=null; gameState='bossDefeated'; postBossTimer=90; }
      } else if(!godMode&&player.invincible<=0&&boss.invincible<=0){
        loseLife(); if(gameState==='gameover') return;
      }
    }
  }

  /* ── Moedas ── */
  for(const c of coins){
    if(!c.collected&&player.x<c.x+15&&player.x+player.width>c.x&&
       player.y<c.y+15&&player.y+player.height>c.y){
      c.collected=true; totalCoins++; updateDisplay();
    }
  }

  /* ── Bandeira ── */
  const bossAlive=boss&&boss.hp>0&&(currentLevel===5||currentLevel===10);
  if(!bossAlive&&
     player.x<flag.x+flag.width&&player.x+player.width>flag.x&&
     player.y<flag.y+flag.height&&player.y+player.height>flag.y&&
     totalCoins>=COINS_PER_LEVEL){
    gameState='win';
  }

  /* Boss derrotado: Enter avança sem precisar da bandeira */
  if(gameState==='bossDefeated'&&postBossTimer<=0&&
     (keys['Enter']||gp?.buttons[0]?.pressed)){
    advanceLevel();
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PRÉDIOS (PRÉ-GERADO UMA VEZ)
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let _bld=null;
function getBuildings(){
  if(_bld) return _bld;
  const raw=[
    [0,140,220],[160,100,270],[280,120,180],[430,90,240],
    [550,150,200],[720,110,260],[860,130,190],[1020,95,280],
    [1140,140,210],[1310,100,250],[1440,120,170],[1590,90,230],
    [1710,150,200],[1890,110,270],[2030,130,180],[2190,100,240],[2320,120,210],
  ];
  _bld=raw.map(([bx,bw,bh],bi)=>{
    const wins=[];
    for(let ox=8;ox<bw-18;ox+=20){
      for(let oy=8;oy<bh-28;oy+=20){
        const seed=(bi*997+ox*31+oy*7)%100;
        wins.push({ox,oy,lit:seed<55});
      }
    }
    return{x:bx,w:bw,h:bh,windows:wins};
  });
  return _bld;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DRAW — BACKGROUND
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function drawBackground(){
  const GY=370;
  const gr=ctx.createLinearGradient(cameraX,0,cameraX,canvas.height);
  if(currentLevel===5){
    gr.addColorStop(0,'#1a0d0d'); gr.addColorStop(1,'#200f10');
  } else if(currentLevel===10){
    gr.addColorStop(0,'#0a0008'); gr.addColorStop(1,'#110011');
  } else if(currentLevel>=6){
    gr.addColorStop(0,'#08080f'); gr.addColorStop(1,'#0e0c18');
  } else {
    gr.addColorStop(0,'#0b1a2e'); gr.addColorStop(1,'#162030');
  }
  ctx.fillStyle=gr; ctx.fillRect(cameraX,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

  /* Prédios */
  const blds=getBuildings();
  const bc=currentLevel>=6?'#080c10':'#0d1520';
  const wc1='#ffd16640', wc2='#5de4ff25';
  for(const b of blds){
    ctx.fillStyle=bc;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x,GY-b.h,b.w,b.h);
    for(const w of b.windows){
      if(w.lit){
        ctx.fillStyle=(b.x+w.oy)%2===0?wc1:wc2;
        ctx.fillRect(b.x+w.ox,GY-b.h+w.oy,10,10);
      }
    }
  }

  /* Postes (fases 1-5) */
  if(currentLevel<=5){
    for(let lx=280;lx<LW;lx+=350){
      ctx.fillStyle='#555';
      ctx.fillRect(lx,GY-65,4,65);
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffd166';
      ctx.fillRect(lx-16,GY-68,32,8);
      const gl=ctx.createRadialGradient(lx+2,GY-60,0,lx+2,GY-60,45);
      gl.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,209,102,0.13)');
      gl.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,209,102,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle=gl;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(lx+2,GY-60,45,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
  } else {
    /* Dutos / canos para fases underground */
    for(let px=150;px<LW;px+=250){
      ctx.fillStyle='#222232';
      ctx.fillRect(px,GY-38,12,38);
      ctx.fillStyle='#2a2a40';
      ctx.fillRect(px-8,GY-42,28,6);
    }
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DRAW — MUNDO
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function drawPlatforms(){
  for(const p of platforms){
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color; ctx.fillRect(p.x,p.y,p.width,p.height);
    ctx.strokeStyle=p.stroke||'#3d3d50'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
    for(let i=0;i<p.width;i+=24) ctx.strokeRect(p.x+i,p.y,24,p.height);
  }
}

function drawCoins(){
  const t=Date.now();
  for(const c of coins){
    if(c.collected) continue;
    const bob=Math.sin(t/400+c.x)*2;
    ctx.fillStyle='#FFD700';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x+7,c.y+7+bob,8,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#FFA500'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='#FFF8DC';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x+5,c.y+4+bob,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawBullets(){
  for(const b of playerBullets){
    ctx.fillStyle='#f1c40f'; ctx.fillRect(b.x,b.y,b.width,b.height);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';    ctx.fillRect(b.x+2,b.y+1,4,b.height-2);
  }
  for(const b of enemyBullets){
    ctx.fillStyle=b.isBoss?'#e74c3c':'#e67e22';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x,b.y,b.width,b.height);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff9900'; ctx.fillRect(b.x+2,b.y+1,3,b.height-2);
  }
}

function drawEnemies(){
  for(const e of enemies){
    if(e.type==='walker'){
      ctx.fillStyle=e.color; ctx.fillRect(e.x,e.y,e.width,e.height);
      ctx.fillStyle='white';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x+5,e.y+5,8,8); ctx.fillRect(e.x+17,e.y+5,8,8);
      ctx.fillStyle='black';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x+7,e.y+7,4,4); ctx.fillRect(e.x+19,e.y+7,4,4);

    } else if(e.type==='flyer'){
      ctx.fillStyle=e.color; ctx.fillRect(e.x,e.y,e.width,e.height);
      ctx.fillStyle='#f39c12';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(e.x-5,e.y+10);ctx.lineTo(e.x-15,e.y);ctx.lineTo(e.x-5,e.y+20); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(e.x+e.width+5,e.y+10);ctx.lineTo(e.x+e.width+15,e.y);ctx.lineTo(e.x+e.width+5,e.y+20); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='white';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x+5,e.y+8,8,8); ctx.fillRect(e.x+17,e.y+8,8,8);
      ctx.fillStyle='black';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x+7,e.y+10,4,4); ctx.fillRect(e.x+19,e.y+10,4,4);

    } else if(e.type==='shooter'){
      ctx.fillStyle=e.color; ctx.fillRect(e.x,e.y,e.width,e.height);
      /* chapéu */
      ctx.fillStyle='#5b2c6f';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x-2,e.y-7,e.width+4,8);
      ctx.fillRect(e.x+4,e.y-14,e.width-8,9);
      /* arma */
      ctx.fillStyle='#444';
      if(e.facing===1){
        ctx.fillRect(e.x+e.width,e.y+12,12,6);
        ctx.fillRect(e.x+e.width+10,e.y+10,3,10);
      } else {
        ctx.fillRect(e.x-12,e.y+12,12,6);
        ctx.fillRect(e.x-13,e.y+10,3,10);
      }
      /* olhos vermelhos */
      ctx.fillStyle='white';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x+5,e.y+5,8,8); ctx.fillRect(e.x+19,e.y+5,7,8);
      ctx.fillStyle='#e74c3c';
      ctx.fillRect(e.x+7,e.y+7,4,4); ctx.fillRect(e.x+21,e.y+7,3,4);
    }
  }
}

function drawBoss(){
  if(!boss||boss.hp<=0) return;
  const flash=boss.invincible>0&&boss.invincible%6<3;
  const bx=boss.x, by=boss.y;

  if(boss.type==='boss1'){
    /* Corpo */
    ctx.fillStyle=flash?'#f1c40f':boss.color;
    ctx.fillRect(bx,by,boss.width,boss.height);
    /* Chapéu fedora */
    ctx.fillStyle=flash?'#f39c12':'#7b241c';
    ctx.fillRect(bx-5,by-10,boss.width+10,12);
    ctx.fillRect(bx+5,by-26,boss.width-10,18);
    /* Cicatriz */
    if(!flash){
      ctx.strokeStyle='#922b21'; ctx.lineWidth=2.5;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bx+15,by+10); ctx.lineTo(bx+22,by+24); ctx.stroke();
    }
    /* Olhos */
    ctx.fillStyle='white';
    ctx.fillRect(bx+10,by+12,10,10); ctx.fillRect(bx+30,by+12,10,10);
    ctx.fillStyle='#1a1a1a';
    ctx.fillRect(bx+13,by+15,5,5); ctx.fillRect(bx+33,by+15,5,5);
    /* Gravata */
    if(!flash){
      ctx.fillStyle='#7b241c';
      ctx.fillRect(bx+20,by+30,10,boss.height-30);
    }
  } else {
    /* Don Diamante: terno preto com listras douradas */
    ctx.fillStyle=flash?'#f1c40f':'#1a0d05';
    ctx.fillRect(bx,by,boss.width,boss.height);
    if(!flash){
      ctx.strokeStyle='#8B6914'; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
      for(let sx=bx+7;sx<bx+boss.width-5;sx+=10){
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx,by); ctx.lineTo(sx,by+boss.height); ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    /* Fedora preto */
    ctx.fillStyle=flash?'#888':'#0d0a05';
    ctx.fillRect(bx-8,by-12,boss.width+16,13);
    ctx.fillRect(bx+5,by-28,boss.width-10,18);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8B6914';
    ctx.fillRect(bx-5,by-14,boss.width+10,4);
    /* Olhos vermelhos grandes */
    ctx.fillStyle='#e74c3c';
    ctx.fillRect(bx+12,by+14,12,12); ctx.fillRect(bx+38,by+14,12,12);
    ctx.fillStyle='black';
    ctx.fillRect(bx+15,by+17,6,6); ctx.fillRect(bx+41,by+17,6,6);
    /* Gravata dourada */
    if(!flash){
      ctx.fillStyle='#8B6914';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(bx+26,by+30); ctx.lineTo(bx+20,by+boss.height-10);
      ctx.lineTo(bx+32,by+boss.height-10); ctx.lineTo(bx+36,by+30);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  /* Barra de HP */
  const bw2=boss.width+20;
  ctx.fillStyle='#e74c3c'; ctx.fillRect(bx-10,by-22,bw2,10);
  ctx.fillStyle='#2ecc71'; ctx.fillRect(bx-10,by-22,bw2*(boss.hp/boss.maxHp),10);
  ctx.strokeStyle='white'; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.strokeRect(bx-10,by-22,bw2,10);

  /* Nome */
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(bx+boss.width/2,by-32);
  ctx.fillStyle='#f1c40f'; ctx.font='bold 11px Arial'; ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText(boss.name,0,0); ctx.restore();
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const vis=player.invincible%10<5||player.invincible<=0||godMode;
  if(!vis) return;
  const px=player.x, py=player.y;

  if(godMode){
    ctx.strokeStyle='#f1c40f'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.strokeRect(px-3,py-3,player.width+6,player.height+6);
  }

  /* Corpo (terno) */
  ctx.fillStyle=godMode?'#f1c40f':(player.dashing?'#5de4ff':player.color);
  ctx.fillRect(px,py,player.width,player.height);

  if(!godMode){
    /* Camisa branca e gravata */
    ctx.fillStyle='#ecf0f1'; ctx.fillRect(px+10,py+5,10,18);
    ctx.fillStyle='#e74c3c';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(px+12,py+5); ctx.lineTo(px+10,py+22);
    ctx.lineTo(px+18,py+22); ctx.lineTo(px+18,py+5); ctx.fill();
  }

  /* Chapéu */
  ctx.fillStyle=godMode?'#f39c12':'#0d1b2a';
  ctx.fillRect(px-2,py-8,player.width+4,10);
  ctx.fillRect(px+3,py-16,player.width-6,10);

  /* Olho */
  ctx.fillStyle='white';
  if(player.facing===1) ctx.fillRect(px+20,py+8,8,8);
  else                  ctx.fillRect(px+2,py+8,8,8);
  ctx.fillStyle='#1a1a1a';
  if(player.facing===1) ctx.fillRect(px+22,py+10,4,4);
  else                  ctx.fillRect(px+4,py+10,4,4);

  /* Arma (exceto no dash / godMode) */
  if(!player.dashing&&!godMode){
    ctx.fillStyle='#444';
    if(player.facing===1) ctx.fillRect(px+player.width,py+18,9,4);
    else                  ctx.fillRect(px-9,py+18,9,4);
  }

  /* Rastro do dash */
  if(player.dashing){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(93,228,255,0.3)';
    ctx.fillRect(px-player.facing*22,py+5,22,player.height-10);
  }
}

function drawFlag(){
  const bossAlive=boss&&boss.hp>0&&(currentLevel===5||currentLevel===10);
  if(bossAlive) return;
  ctx.fillStyle='#8B4513'; ctx.fillRect(flag.x,flag.y,5,flag.height);
  const fc=['#e74c3c','#3498db','#f1c40f','#9b59b6','#e67e22',
             '#1abc9c','#e74c3c','#3498db','#f1c40f','#9b59b6'];
  ctx.fillStyle=fc[currentLevel-1]||'#e74c3c';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(flag.x+5,flag.y); ctx.lineTo(flag.x+30,flag.y+15); ctx.lineTo(flag.x+5,flag.y+30);
  ctx.fill();
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DRAW — MENU
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function drawMenuScreen(){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,canvas.height);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0b1a2e'); g.addColorStop(1,'#0d0a1a');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

  /* Skyline */
  ctx.fillStyle='#0d1520';
  [[0,160,120],[140,180,80],[240,150,140],[400,200,70],
   [490,130,90],[600,190,100],[720,160,110],[850,140,80]].forEach(([x,h,w])=>{
    ctx.fillRect(x,canvas.height-30-h,w,h);
  });

  /* Título */
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillStyle='#e74c3c'; ctx.font='bold 20px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('SUPER AVENTUREIRO 2',canvas.width/2,48);
  ctx.fillStyle='#f1c40f'; ctx.font='bold 28px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('✦  AGENT EDITION  ✦',canvas.width/2,82);

  /* Painel de história */
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(50,100,canvas.width-100,130);
  ctx.fillStyle='#bdc3c7'; ctx.font='13px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Depois de suas férias na praia, alguém roubou seu',canvas.width/2,125);
  ctx.fillStyle='#f1c40f'; ctx.font='bold 16px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('💎  DIAMANTE MAIS PRECIOSO  💎',canvas.width/2,150);
  ctx.fillStyle='#bdc3c7'; ctx.font='13px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('A máfia está por trás de tudo. Não existe negociação.',canvas.width/2,172);
  ctx.fillText('Vista o terno, carregue a arma e vire o agente secreto',canvas.width/2,192);
  ctx.fillStyle='#f1c40f'; ctx.font='bold 13px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('que vai varrer a máfia da cidade e recuperar o que é seu.',canvas.width/2,212);

  /* Destaques do jogo */
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.4)'; ctx.fillRect(50,242,canvas.width-100,48);
  ctx.fillStyle='#5de4ff'; ctx.font='12px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('Z / B = ATIRAR  ·  SHIFT / X = DASH  ·  2× PULO a partir da Missão 6',canvas.width/2,262);
  ctx.fillStyle='#888'; ctx.font='11px Arial';
  ctx.fillText('R+L ou LB+RB = MODO INVENCÍVEL   |   10 missões   |   2 bosses',canvas.width/2,282);

  /* Pressione ENTER (piscando) */
  if(Math.floor(Date.now()/500)%2===0){
    ctx.fillStyle='#f1c40f'; ctx.font='bold 17px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('▶  PRESSIONE ENTER / A PARA COMEÇAR  ◀',canvas.width/2,358);
  }
  ctx.textAlign='left';
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DRAW — OVERLAYS (espaço de tela)
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function drawOverlays(){
  ctx.textAlign='center';

  /* Pulo duplo desbloqueado */
  if(doubleJumpMsgTimer>0){
    const a=Math.min(1,doubleJumpMsgTimer/40);
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(0,0,0,${0.65*a})`;
    ctx.fillRect(170,8,canvas.width-340,50);
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(93,228,255,${a})`;
    ctx.font='bold 19px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('✦  PULO DUPLO DESBLOQUEADO!  ✦',canvas.width/2,40);
  }

  if(gameState==='gameover'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.78)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle='#e74c3c'; ctx.font='38px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('MISSÃO FALHOU',canvas.width/2,canvas.height/2-22);
    ctx.fillStyle='white'; ctx.font='17px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Pressione ENTER ou 🎮 A para recomeçar',canvas.width/2,canvas.height/2+28);

  } else if(gameState==='win'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.78)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle='#f1c40f'; ctx.font='34px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(
      currentLevel<10?`MISSÃO ${currentLevel} COMPLETA!`:'🏆 DIAMANTE RECUPERADO!',
      canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2-22
    );
    ctx.fillStyle='white'; ctx.font='17px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(
      currentLevel<10?'Pressione ENTER para a próxima missão':'Pressione ENTER para jogar novamente',
      canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2+28
    );

  } else if(gameState==='bossDefeated'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.72)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle='#2ecc71'; ctx.font='32px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('BOSS ELIMINADO!',canvas.width/2,canvas.height/2-45);
    ctx.fillStyle='#f1c40f'; ctx.font='17px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(
      currentLevel===5?'💀 Tenente Scarface neutralizado!':'💎 Don Diamante caiu!',
      canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2-10
    );
    ctx.fillStyle='white'; ctx.font='14px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Colete as moedas e vá até a bandeira',canvas.width/2,canvas.height/2+20);
    if(postBossTimer<=0&&Math.floor(Date.now()/600)%2===0){
      ctx.fillStyle='#f1c40f'; ctx.font='13px Arial';
      ctx.fillText('(ou ENTER / A para avançar diretamente)',canvas.width/2,canvas.height/2+42);
    }
  }

  ctx.textAlign='left';
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DRAW PRINCIPAL
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

  if(gameState==='menu'){ drawMenuScreen(); return; }

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(-cameraX,0);
  drawBackground();
  drawPlatforms();
  drawCoins();
  drawBullets();
  drawEnemies();
  drawBoss();
  drawFlag();
  drawPlayer();
  ctx.restore();

  drawOverlays();
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GAME LOOP
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function gameLoop(){ update(); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop); }

loadLevel(1);
gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

        function isBeachLevel(level) { return level >= 6; }

        function getPlatformColors(level) {
            if (isBeachLevel(level)) return { ground: '#C9952B', plat: '#E8C874' };
            return { ground: '#8B4513', plat: '#654321' };
        }

        function getEnemyColors(level) {
            if (level >= 6 && level <= 9) {
                const beach = [
                    { walker: '#E76F51', flyer: '#457B9D' },
                    { walker: '#F4A261', flyer: '#2A9D8F' },
                    { walker: '#D62828', flyer: '#023E8A' },
                    { walker: '#BC6C25', flyer: '#0077B6' }
                ];
                return beach[level - 6];
            }
            if (level === 10) return { walker: '#E76F51', flyer: '#0077B6' };
            switch (level) {
                case 1: return { walker: '#27ae60', flyer: '#e67e22' };
                case 2: return { walker: '#2980b9', flyer: '#f39c12' };
                case 3: return { walker: '#8e44ad', flyer: '#e74c3c' };
                case 4: return { walker: '#c0392b', flyer: '#e74c3c' };
                case 5: return { walker: '#2c3e50', flyer: '#c0392b' };
                default: return { walker: '#27ae60', flyer: '#e67e22' };
            }
        }
