                    platforms.push({ x: 1520, y: 260, width: 80, height: 15, color: pc.plat });
                    platforms.push({ x: 1700, y: 210, width: 80, height: 15, color: pc.plat });
                    platforms.push({ x: 1880, y: 270, width: 80, height: 15, color: pc.plat });
                    platforms.push({ x: 2060, y: 220, width: 80, height: 15, color: pc.plat });
                    enemies.push({ x: 150, y: 340, width: 30, height: 30, vx: 3.5, color: colors.walker, type: 'walker' });
                    enemies.push({ x: 550, y: 340, width: 30, height: 30, vx: -3.6, color: colors.walker, type: 'walker' });
                    enemies.push({ x: 1050, y: 340, width: 30, height: 30, vx: 3.4, color: colors.walker, type: 'walker' });
                    enemies.push({ x: 1550, y: 340, width: 30, height: 30, vx: -3.7, color: colors.walker, type: 'walker' });
                    enemies.push({ x: 700, y: 130, width: 30, height: 30, vx: 3, vy: 0, amplitude: 90, baseY: 130, color: colors.flyer, type: 'flyer' });
                    enemies.push({ x: 1800, y: 140, width: 30, height: 30, vx: -3.1, vy: 0, amplitude: 85, baseY: 140, color: colors.flyer, type: 'flyer' });
                    boss = {
                        x: 1950, y: 260, width: 70, height: 100, vx: 2.5, vy: 0,
                        hp: 5, maxHp: 5, color: '#E76F51', invincible: 0,
                        type: 'beachBoss', attackCooldown: 0
                    };
                    coins.push({ x: 110, y: 310 }, { x: 290, y: 260 }, { x: 470, y: 210 }, { x: 650, y: 160 });
                    coins.push({ x: 1010, y: 270 }, { x: 1370, y: 200 }, { x: 1730, y: 230 }, { x: 2090, y: 190 });
                    flag = { x: 2300, y: 310, width: 20, height: 60 };
                    break;
            }

            coins.forEach(c => c.collected = false);
            player.x = 50; player.y = 300; player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
            player.dashing = false; player.dashCooldown = 0; player.dashDuration = 0;
            player.invincible = 0; totalCoins = 0; cameraX = 0;
            updateDisplay();
        }

        function updateDisplay() {
            if (gameState === 'menu') {
                document.getElementById('levelDisplay').textContent = '🏖️ SUPER AVENTUREIRO 2: BEACH EXPANSION';
            } else if (gameState === 'controls') {
                document.getElementById('levelDisplay').textContent = '📖 CONTROLES';
            } else {
                const tag = isBeachLevel(currentLevel) ? ' 🏖️' : '';
                document.getElementById('levelDisplay').textContent = `FASE ${currentLevel} / ${TOTAL_LEVELS}${tag}`;
            }
            document.getElementById('scoreDisplay').textContent = `⭐ Moedas: ${totalCoins} / ${coinsPerLevel}`;
            document.getElementById('livesDisplay').textContent = godMode ? '👑 ∞ Vidas' : `❤️ Vidas: ${lives}`;
            document.getElementById('godmodeDisplay').style.display = godMode ? 'block' : 'none';
        }

        function startGame() {
            gameState = 'playing';
            currentLevel = 1;
            lives = 3;
            loadLevel(1);
            updateDisplay();
        }

        window.addEventListener('gamepadconnected', () => { gamepadConnected = true; });
        window.addEventListener('gamepaddisconnected', () => { gamepadConnected = false; });

        window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            keys[e.code] = true;
            if (['Space', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ShiftLeft', 'ShiftRight'].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
        });
        window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.code] = false; });

        function getGamepadInput() {
            const gamepads = navigator.getGamepads();
            if (!gamepads) return null;
            for (const gp of gamepads) {
                if (gp && gp.connected) {
                    gamepadConnected = true;
                    return gp;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        function handleGodMode(gamepad) {
            const kbActive = !!(keys['KeyR'] && keys['KeyL']);
            const gpActive = !!(gamepad && gamepad.buttons[4]?.pressed && gamepad.buttons[5]?.pressed);
            const comboActive = kbActive || gpActive;
            if (comboActive && !godComboWasActive) {
                godMode = !godMode;
                updateDisplay();
            }
            godComboWasActive = comboActive;
        }

        function updateMenuInput(gamepad) {
            if (menuNavCooldown > 0) menuNavCooldown--;
            if (menuConfirmCooldown > 0) menuConfirmCooldown--;

            const up = keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'] || gamepad?.buttons[12]?.pressed || (gamepad && gamepad.axes[1] < -0.5);
            const down = keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['KeyS'] || gamepad?.buttons[13]?.pressed || (gamepad && gamepad.axes[1] > 0.5);
            const confirm = keys['Enter'] || keys['Space'] || gamepad?.buttons[0]?.pressed;
            const back = keys['Escape'] || keys['Backspace'] || gamepad?.buttons[1]?.pressed;

            if (gameState === 'menu') {
                if ((up || down) && menuNavCooldown <= 0) {
                    menuSelection = (menuSelection + (down ? 1 : -1) + menuOptions.length) % menuOptions.length;
                    menuNavCooldown = 15;
                }
                if (confirm && menuConfirmCooldown <= 0) {
                    menuConfirmCooldown = 20;
                    if (menuOptions[menuSelection] === 'JOGAR') startGame();
                    else { gameState = 'controls'; updateDisplay(); }
                }
            } else if (gameState === 'controls') {
                if (back && menuConfirmCooldown <= 0) {
                    menuConfirmCooldown = 20;
                    gameState = 'menu';
                    updateDisplay();
                }
            }
        }

        function update() {
            const gamepad = getGamepadInput();
            handleGodMode(gamepad);

            if (gameState === 'menu' || gameState === 'controls') {
                updateMenuInput(gamepad);
                return;
            }

            if (gameState === 'gameover' || gameState === 'win' || gameState === 'bossDefeated') {
                if (keys['Enter'] || gamepad?.buttons[0]?.pressed) {
                    if (gameState === 'gameover') {
                        if (!godMode) lives--;
                        if (!godMode && lives <= 0) { lives = 3; currentLevel = 1; }
                        loadLevel(currentLevel);
                        gameState = 'playing';
                    } else if (gameState === 'win' || gameState === 'bossDefeated') {
                        if (currentLevel < TOTAL_LEVELS) {
                            currentLevel++;
                            loadLevel(currentLevel);
                            gameState = 'playing';
                        } else {
                            currentLevel = 1; lives = 3;
                            loadLevel(1); gameState = 'menu'; menuSelection = 0;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return;
            }

            if (player.invincible > 0) player.invincible--;
            if (player.dashCooldown > 0) player.dashCooldown--;

            let moveLeft = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'];
            let moveRight = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'];
            let jump = keys['Space'] || keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'];
            let dash = keys['ShiftLeft'] || keys['ShiftRight'] || keys['KeyX'];

            if (gamepad) {
                if (gamepad.axes[0] < -0.5) moveLeft = true;
                if (gamepad.axes[0] > 0.5) moveRight = true;
                if (gamepad.buttons[14]?.pressed) moveLeft = true;
                if (gamepad.buttons[15]?.pressed) moveRight = true;
                if (gamepad.buttons[0]?.pressed) jump = true;
                if (gamepad.buttons[2]?.pressed) dash = true;
            }

            if (dash && !player.dashing && player.dashCooldown <= 0) {
                player.dashing = true; player.dashDuration = 10; player.dashCooldown = 30; player.vy = 0;
            }
            if (player.dashing) {
                player.vx = player.facing * player.dashSpeed;
                player.dashDuration--;
                if (player.dashDuration <= 0) { player.dashing = false; player.vx = 0; }
            } else {
                if (moveLeft) { player.vx = -player.speed; player.facing = -1; }
                else if (moveRight) { player.vx = player.speed; player.facing = 1; }
                else player.vx = 0;
            }

            if (jump && player.grounded) { player.vy = player.jumpForce; player.grounded = false; }
            player.vy += player.gravity;
            player.y += player.vy;

            player.grounded = false;
            for (const plat of platforms) {
                if (player.x < plat.x + plat.width && player.x + player.width > plat.x &&
                    player.y < plat.y + plat.height && player.y + player.height > plat.y) {
                    if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.height - player.vy <= plat.y) {
                        player.y = plat.y - player.height; player.vy = 0; player.grounded = true;
                    } else if (player.vy < 0 && player.y - player.vy >= plat.y + plat.height) {
                        player.y = plat.y + plat.height; player.vy = 0;
                    }
                }
            }

            player.x += player.vx;
            for (const plat of platforms) {
                if (player.x < plat.x + plat.width && player.x + player.width > plat.x &&
                    player.y < plat.y + plat.height && player.y + player.height > plat.y) {
                    if (player.vx > 0) player.x = plat.x - player.width;
                    else if (player.vx < 0) player.x = plat.x + plat.width;
                    player.vx = 0;
                }
            }

            if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
            if (player.x > levelWidth - player.width) player.x = levelWidth - player.width;
            cameraX = Math.max(0, Math.min(player.x - canvas.width / 3, levelWidth - canvas.width));

            if (player.y > canvas.height) {
                if (godMode) { player.y = 300; player.vy = 0; player.x = 50; cameraX = 0; }
                else loseLife();
            }

            for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const enemy = enemies[i];
                if (enemy.type === 'walker') {
                    enemy.x += enemy.vx;
                    let grounded = false;
                    for (const plat of platforms) {
                        if (enemy.x < plat.x + plat.width && enemy.x + enemy.width > plat.x &&
                            enemy.y + enemy.height <= plat.y + plat.height && enemy.y + enemy.height >= plat.y) grounded = true;
                    }
                    if (enemy.x <= 0 || enemy.x >= levelWidth - enemy.width || !grounded) enemy.vx = -enemy.vx;
                } else if (enemy.type === 'flyer') {
                    enemy.x += enemy.vx;
                    enemy.y = enemy.baseY + Math.sin(Date.now() / 500) * enemy.amplitude;
                    if (enemy.x <= 0 || enemy.x >= levelWidth - enemy.width) enemy.vx = -enemy.vx;
                }
                if (player.x < enemy.x + enemy.width && player.x + player.width > enemy.x &&
                    player.y < enemy.y + enemy.height && player.y + player.height > enemy.y) {
                    if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.height - player.vy <= enemy.y + 10) {
                        enemies.splice(i, 1); player.vy = player.jumpForce * 1.4;
                    } else if (player.dashing) enemies.splice(i, 1);
                    else if (!godMode && player.invincible <= 0) loseLife();
                }
            }

            if (boss && boss.hp > 0) {
                if (boss.invincible > 0) boss.invincible--;
                boss.x += boss.vx;
                const minX = boss.type === 'beachBoss' ? 1650 : 1700;
                if (boss.x <= minX || boss.x >= levelWidth - boss.width - 50) boss.vx = -boss.vx;

                if (player.x < boss.x + boss.width && player.x + player.width > boss.x &&
                    player.y < boss.y + boss.height && player.y + player.height > boss.y) {
                    if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.height - player.vy <= boss.y + 15 && boss.invincible <= 0) {
                        boss.hp--; boss.invincible = 30;
                        player.vy = player.jumpForce * 1.5; player.y = boss.y - player.height;
                        if (boss.hp <= 0) { boss = null; gameState = 'bossDefeated'; }
                    } else if (player.dashing && boss.invincible <= 0) {
                        boss.hp--; boss.invincible = 30; player.vx = -player.facing * 8;
                        if (boss.hp <= 0) { boss = null; gameState = 'bossDefeated'; }
                    } else if (!godMode && player.invincible <= 0 && boss.invincible <= 0) loseLife();
                }
            }

            for (const coin of coins) {
                if (!coin.collected && player.x < coin.x + 15 && player.x + player.width > coin.x &&
                    player.y < coin.y + 15 && player.y + player.height > coin.y) {
                    coin.collected = true; totalCoins++; updateDisplay();
                }
            }

            const bossBlocksFlag = (currentLevel === 5 || currentLevel === 10) && boss && boss.hp > 0;
            if (!bossBlocksFlag && player.x < flag.x + flag.width && player.x + player.width > flag.x &&
                player.y < flag.y + flag.height && player.y + player.height > flag.y && totalCoins >= coinsPerLevel) {
                gameState = 'win';
            }
            if (gameState === 'bossDefeated' && player.x < flag.x + flag.width && player.x + player.width > flag.x &&
                player.y < flag.y + flag.height && player.y + player.height > flag.y && totalCoins >= coinsPerLevel) {
                gameState = 'win';
            }
        }

        function loseLife() {
            if (godMode) return;
            lives--; updateDisplay();
            if (lives <= 0) { gameState = 'gameover'; lives = 0; }
            else { player.x = 50; player.y = 300; player.vy = 0; player.invincible = 60; cameraX = 0; }
        }

        function drawBeachDecorations() {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD166';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(200, 60, 35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();

            ctx.fillStyle = '#0077B6';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 300, levelWidth, 70);

            for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                const px = (i * 320 + 80) % levelWidth;
                ctx.fillStyle = '#2D6A4F';
                ctx.fillRect(px, 280, 8, 40);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#40916C';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(px - 20, 290);
                ctx.lineTo(px + 4, 250);
                ctx.lineTo(px + 28, 290);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(px + 4, 290);
                ctx.lineTo(px + 30, 255);
                ctx.lineTo(px + 50, 290);
                ctx.fill();
            }

            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
            for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
                const wx = (i * 400 + Date.now() / 30) % levelWidth;
                ctx.fillRect(wx, 320, 60, 4);
                ctx.fillRect(wx + 20, 328, 40, 3);
            }
        }

        function drawBeachBoss(b) {
            const flash = b.invincible % 10 < 5;
            ctx.fillStyle = flash ? b.color : '#FFD166';
            ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y + 20, b.width, b.height - 20);
            ctx.fillStyle = flash ? '#D62828' : '#FF6B35';
            ctx.fillRect(b.x - 15, b.y + 50, 20, 35);
            ctx.fillRect(b.x + b.width - 5, b.y + 50, 20, 35);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#D62828';
            ctx.fillRect(b.x + 8, b.y + 30, 14, 14);
            ctx.fillRect(b.x + b.width - 22, b.y + 30, 14, 14);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
            ctx.fillRect(b.x + 12, b.y + 34, 6, 6);
            ctx.fillRect(b.x + b.width - 18, b.y + 34, 6, 6);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#E76F51';
            ctx.fillRect(b.x + 20, b.y + 55, 30, 8);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#2D6A4F';
            ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y - 45, b.width, 8);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#40916C';
            ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y - 45, b.width * (b.hp / b.maxHp), 8);
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'white';
            ctx.strokeRect(b.x, b.y - 45, b.width, 8);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD166';
            ctx.font = '12px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('REI CARANGUEJO', b.x + b.width / 2, b.y - 52);
        }

        function draw() {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(-cameraX, 0);

            const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
            if (isBeachLevel(currentLevel)) {
                gradient.addColorStop(0, '#48CAE4');
                gradient.addColorStop(0.6, '#90E0EF');
                gradient.addColorStop(1, '#CAF0F8');
            } else if (currentLevel === 5) {
                gradient.addColorStop(0, '#2c3e50');
                gradient.addColorStop(1, '#34495e');
            } else {
                gradient.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB');
                gradient.addColorStop(1, '#98FB98');
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, levelWidth, canvas.height);

            if (isBeachLevel(currentLevel)) drawBeachDecorations();
            else if (currentLevel !== 5) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                    const cloudX = (i * 250 + 100) % levelWidth;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(cloudX, 50, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.arc(cloudX + 30, 45, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.arc(cloudX + 60, 50, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            }

            for (const plat of platforms) {
                ctx.fillStyle = plat.color;
                ctx.fillRect(plat.x, plat.y, plat.width, plat.height);
                ctx.strokeStyle = isBeachLevel(currentLevel) ? '#A67C00' : '#3e2723';
                ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                for (let i = 0; i < plat.width; i += 20) ctx.strokeRect(plat.x + i, plat.y, 20, plat.height);
            }

            for (const coin of coins) {
                if (!coin.collected) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
                    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(coin.x + 7, coin.y + 7, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFA500'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF8DC';
                    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(coin.x + 5, coin.y + 5, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
                }
            }

            for (const enemy of enemies) {
                if (enemy.type === 'walker') {
                    ctx.fillStyle = enemy.color;
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x, enemy.y, enemy.width, enemy.height);
                    if (isBeachLevel(currentLevel)) {
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#D62828';
                        ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 5, enemy.y + 22, 8, 6);
                        ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 17, enemy.y + 22, 8, 6);
                    }
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 5, enemy.y + 5, 8, 8);
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 17, enemy.y + 5, 8, 8);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 7, enemy.y + 7, 4, 4);
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 19, enemy.y + 7, 4, 4);
                } else if (enemy.type === 'flyer') {
                    ctx.fillStyle = enemy.color;
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x, enemy.y, enemy.width, enemy.height);
                    ctx.fillStyle = isBeachLevel(currentLevel) ? '#CAF0F8' : '#f39c12';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(enemy.x - 5, enemy.y + 10); ctx.lineTo(enemy.x - 15, enemy.y); ctx.lineTo(enemy.x - 5, enemy.y + 20); ctx.fill();
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(enemy.x + enemy.width + 5, enemy.y + 10); ctx.lineTo(enemy.x + enemy.width + 15, enemy.y); ctx.lineTo(enemy.x + enemy.width + 5, enemy.y + 20); ctx.fill();
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 5, enemy.y + 8, 8, 8);
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 17, enemy.y + 8, 8, 8);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 7, enemy.y + 10, 4, 4);
                    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x + 19, enemy.y + 10, 4, 4);
                }
            }

            if (boss && boss.hp > 0) {
                if (boss.type === 'beachBoss') drawBeachBoss(boss);
                else {
                    ctx.fillStyle = boss.invincible % 10 < 5 ? boss.color : '#f1c40f';
                    ctx.fillRect(boss.x, boss.y, boss.width, boss.height);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(boss.x, boss.y); ctx.lineTo(boss.x + 10, boss.y - 20); ctx.lineTo(boss.x + 20, boss.y - 5);
                    ctx.lineTo(boss.x + 30, boss.y - 25); ctx.lineTo(boss.x + 40, boss.y - 5); ctx.lineTo(boss.x + 50, boss.y - 20);
                    ctx.lineTo(boss.x + 60, boss.y); ctx.fill();
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
                    ctx.fillRect(boss.x + 10, boss.y + 10, 12, 12);
                    ctx.fillRect(boss.x + 38, boss.y + 10, 12, 12);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
                    ctx.fillRect(boss.x + 14, boss.y + 14, 4, 4);
                    ctx.fillRect(boss.x + 42, boss.y + 14, 4, 4);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
                    ctx.fillRect(boss.x, boss.y - 35, boss.width, 8);
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
                    ctx.fillRect(boss.x, boss.y - 35, boss.width * (boss.hp / boss.maxHp), 8);
                    ctx.strokeStyle = 'white';
                    ctx.strokeRect(boss.x, boss.y - 35, boss.width, 8);
                }
            }

            const bossBlocksFlag = (currentLevel === 5 || currentLevel === 10) && boss && boss.hp > 0;
            if (!bossBlocksFlag) {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
                ctx.fillRect(flag.x, flag.y, 5, flag.height);
                const flagColors = ['#e74c3c', '#3498db', '#f1c40f', '#9b59b6', '#e67e22', '#00B4D8', '#FF6B35', '#2A9D8F', '#FFD166', '#E76F51'];
                ctx.fillStyle = flagColors[currentLevel - 1];
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(flag.x + 5, flag.y);
                ctx.lineTo(flag.x + 30, flag.y + 15);
                ctx.lineTo(flag.x + 5, flag.y + 30);
                ctx.fill();
            }

            if (player.invincible % 10 < 5 || player.invincible <= 0 || godMode) {
                ctx.fillStyle = godMode ? '#f1c40f' : (player.dashing ? '#f39c12' : player.color);
                ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.width, player.height);
                if (godMode) {
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#f1c40f'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
                    ctx.strokeRect(player.x - 3, player.y - 3, player.width + 6, player.height + 6);
                }
                if (isBeachLevel(currentLevel)) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD166';
                    ctx.fillRect(player.x + 5, player.y - 5, player.width - 10, 6);
                } else {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#c0392b';
                    ctx.fillRect(player.x - 2, player.y - 8, player.width + 4, 10);
                }
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                if (player.facing === 1) ctx.fillRect(player.x + 20, player.y + 8, 8, 8);
                else ctx.fillRect(player.x + 2, player.y + 8, 8, 8);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
                if (player.facing === 1) ctx.fillRect(player.x + 22, player.y + 10, 4, 4);
                else ctx.fillRect(player.x + 4, player.y + 10, 4, 4);
            }

            ctx.restore();

            if (gameState === 'menu') {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 60, 100, 0.85)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD166';
                ctx.font = '36px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText('SUPER AVENTUREIRO 2', canvas.width / 2, 70);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#48CAE4';
                ctx.font = '28px Arial';
                ctx.fillText('🏖️ BEACH EXPANSION 🏖️', canvas.width / 2, 110);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#CAF0F8';
                ctx.font = '16px Arial';
                ctx.fillText('DLC · 10 Fases · Novo Boss da Praia', canvas.width / 2, 140);

                menuOptions.forEach((opt, i) => {
                    const selected = i === menuSelection;
                    ctx.fillStyle = selected ? '#FFD166' : '#90E0EF';
                    ctx.font = selected ? 'bold 28px Arial' : '24px Arial';
                    const prefix = selected ? '▶ ' : '   ';
                    ctx.fillText(prefix + opt, canvas.width / 2, 210 + i * 45);
                });

                ctx.fillStyle = '#CAF0F8';
                ctx.font = '14px Arial';
                ctx.fillText('↑↓ Navegar · ENTER/A Confirmar · 🎮 Gamepad OK', canvas.width / 2, 340);
                if (Math.sin(Date.now() / 500) > 0) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD166';
                    ctx.font = '16px Arial';
                    ctx.fillText('10 fases · 5 originais + 5 de praia', canvas.width / 2, 370);
                }
            } else if (gameState === 'controls') {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 60, 100, 0.9)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD166';
                ctx.font = '32px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText('CONTROLES', canvas.width / 2, 60);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white'; ctx.font = '18px Arial';
                const lines = [
                    'Setas / WASD — Mover',
                    'Espaço / W — Pular',
                    'Shift / X — Dash',
                    'Pular em inimigos — Derrotar',
                    '🎮 Gamepad: D-Pad=Mover | A=Pular | X=Dash',
                    '👑 R+L (teclado) ou LB+RB (gamepad) = Modo Invencível',
                    '',
                    'ESC / B — Voltar ao menu'
                ];
                lines.forEach((line, i) => ctx.fillText(line, canvas.width / 2, 110 + i * 28));
            } else if (gameState === 'gameover') {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c'; ctx.font = '40px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white'; ctx.font = '20px Arial';
                ctx.fillText(`Vidas restantes: ${godMode ? '∞' : lives}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
                ctx.fillText('Pressione ENTER ou 🎮 A para continuar', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 50);
            } else if (gameState === 'win') {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                ctx.fillStyle = isBeachLevel(currentLevel) ? '#FFD166' : '#f1c40f';
                ctx.font = '40px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                if (currentLevel < TOTAL_LEVELS) {
                    ctx.fillText(`FASE ${currentLevel} COMPLETA!`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
                    if (currentLevel === 5) {
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#48CAE4'; ctx.font = '20px Arial';
                        ctx.fillText('🏖️ A Beach Expansion começa agora!', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 10);
                    }
                } else {
                    ctx.fillText('🏆 VITÓRIA NA PRAIA! 🏆', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
                }
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white'; ctx.font = '20px Arial';
                ctx.fillText('Pressione ENTER ou 🎮 A para continuar', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 40);
            } else if (gameState === 'bossDefeated') {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71'; ctx.font = '40px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText(currentLevel === 10 ? 'REI CARANGUEJO DERROTADO!' : 'BOSS DERROTADO!', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white'; ctx.font = '20px Arial';
                ctx.fillText('Agora vá até a bandeira para completar a fase!', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
            }
        }

        function gameLoop() { update(); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop); }

        loadLevel(1);
        gameState = 'menu';
        updateDisplay();
        gameLoop();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
